contea di ritrovamento: North East Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ MANTONINVS AVGTRPXXIII ; R/ LIBERAL AVG V COSIII

Silver Coin. Denarius of Marcus Aurelius (139-180), issue of 169-170, RIC volume 3 no. 206. Obverse description: Bust laureate right, head has curled hair and a forked beard. Obverse inscription: MANTONINVS AVGTRPXXIII. Reverse description: Liberalitas standing left holding cornucopiae and abacus. Reverse inscription: LIBERAL AVG V COSIII. Diameter: 18.3mm, Weight: 3.12gms, die axis: 6
